name: HB reward claim refills PROOF by pulling HB from the HB/USDT pair
summary: A PROOF reward claim makes HERMES.swapBack top PROOF up with up to 200,000 HB taken straight from the HB/USDT pair, then sync it. The attacker flash-borrowed USDT, bought the pair down to 200,000 HB, claimed a reward so the refill took the rest, and sold dust HB into the near-empty reserve for the pair's USDT.
notes: PROOF's implementation, activated 16 blocks after HERMES's, completes the claim-triggered pull, so its upgrade sets the age; HERMES's upgrade installed swapBack's pull from the pair and sync. MAIN's last upgrade is earlier.

Loss is the pair's USDT depletion in the one exploit transaction; the 72.1M USDT buy and later deposits into the pair came from the Moolah flash loan and Venus borrows repaid in the transaction. The HB bought out and moved to PROOF is the same liquidity and is not added.
The attacker's registration and staking transactions before the anchor are setup; no other transaction drained the pair's USDT.
